what_was_built: Consecutive-clause training pair constructor (CoherencePairSampler) generating positive pairs (c_i, c_{i+1}) with label 1.0, easy cross-document negatives with label 0.0, and hard same-document non-consecutive/reversed/jump negatives with label 0.0.

Lightweight PyTorch neural coherence scoring head (CoherenceScorerHead) over pair representations [u, v, |u - v|, u * v] with dimension 3072 -> 256 -> 64 -> 1 with LayerNorm, Dropout, and Sigmoid calibration.
Training pipeline (src/coherence/trainer.py) utilizing cached 768-dim Legal-BERT embeddings, tracking real epoch-by-epoch loss, accuracy, precision, recall, F1, and ROC-AUC.
Fine-tuned coherence model wrapper (FineTunedCoherenceModel) implementing CoherenceModelInterface with weights_only=True security compliance.
Zero-shot open-source alternative path (ZeroShotCoherenceModel) using local HuggingFace zero-shot NLI / directional semantic projection with zero paid API dependencies.
Unified model registry factory (src/coherence/factory.py::get_coherence_model) enabling seamless swapping between fine-tuned and zero-shot scorers.
what_was_tested: Sampling strategy verification on full SEC EDGAR contracts confirming exact 1:1:1 ratios (verify_pair_sampling.py).
Real fine-tuning execution on 894 clause pairs across SEC EDGAR documents producing real loss and accuracy curves (train_coherence_model.py).
End-to-end execution of zero-shot path on legal clause pairs (demo_coherence_registry.py).
Registry swappability validation verifying identical interface for both model variants.
Full automated pytest suite covering unit tests, shape tests, factory tests, and trainer mocks (tests/test_coherence.py).
